en: Sepia-toned studio portrait showing a woman seated on a rustic wooden bench and a uniformed man standing behind and leaning toward her. The woman wears an early 20th‑century long dress, fur stole, large hat with decoration, and holds a handbag. The man wears a dark military-style tunic with stand-up collar, a flat round cap, and white gloves. The background is a painted pastoral backdrop, typical of professional photographic studios. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
